faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 2.2 diesel engine in the Land Rover Discovery Sport. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can an Evoque or Freelander 2 engine fit my Discovery Sport?
faqs.a: Sometimes, but only after checks. Those 2.2 diesel engines can differ in ancillaries, calibration and emissions equipment, so we compare your VIN and engine code with any replacement before supply.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 224DT engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Land Rover SD4 engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery Sport 224DT engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo, DPF or clutch, and whether fitting is included. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 224DT engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 2.2 diesel engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their vehicle to us.

faqs.q: How long does a 224DT engine replacement usually take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed and any additional work found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed throughout.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 224DT?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery Sport guide the decision. Injector seal, EGR, DPF and turbo faults can often be repaired individually. If belt failure has damaged the valves or the bottom end is badly worn, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery Sport 224DT engine replacement is usually more practical.
paragraphs: A replacement diesel only lasts if its supporting systems are healthy. Where relevant, we inspect the turbo, intercooler, EGR valve, DPF, injectors and cooling system, check the gearbox and clutch, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery Sport 2.2 Diesel Faults
engineProblems.description: The 224DT usually gives warning signs early, so prompt checks can prevent much more serious damage.

cards.title: Timing Belt Service Overdue
cards.description: The 2.2 diesel uses a timing belt. Overdue replacement, a worn tensioner or oil contamination can lead to sudden belt failure and serious valve damage. We inspect the belt and tensioner.

cards.title: Injector Seal Blow-By
cards.description: A ticking noise from the top of the engine, a diesel smell or carbon deposits around the injectors may point to leaking injector seals. We inspect the injectors and seal condition.

cards.title: Turbo Actuator and Boost Loss
cards.description: Limp mode, a lack of power or boost fault codes may come from a sticking turbo actuator, worn turbocharger or split intercooler hose. We test boost control and turbo operation.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: DPF Blockage and Regeneration
cards.description: DPF warnings, reduced power or frequent regeneration attempts are common when short journeys stop the particulate filter clearing properly. We read soot data and assess the DPF.

cards.title: EGR Valve Carbon Build-Up
cards.description: Rough idle, hesitation, smoke or EGR fault codes can be caused by carbon deposits in the EGR valve or a failing EGR cooler. We test EGR operation and inspect the cooler.

cards.title: Rising Oil Level and Dilution
cards.description: An oil level that rises between services may indicate fuel entering the sump during repeated or interrupted DPF regenerations. We check oil condition and regeneration history.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery Sport 224DT Engine: The Complete 2.2 Diesel Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery Sport 224DT engine is the 2.2-litre four-cylinder turbodiesel fitted to early TD4 and SD4 Discovery Sport models before the Ingenium diesel arrived. Many are now high-mileage, and timing belt neglect, turbo wear, DPF blockages and injector seal leaks often lead owners to seek repair or replacement.

The Land Rover 2.2 diesel engine was also used in the Evoque and Freelander 2, with differences in ancillaries, calibration and emissions equipment. We identify the correct Discovery Sport 2.2 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery Sport 224DT engine replacement, our team inspects the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
